name: Atishay Limited
summary: Atishay Limited is an information technology-centric company that offers a diverse portfolio of services, including data processing, various computer-related activities, and operations within the hospitality sector, specifically hotels and motels. Its business is structured into two main divisions: E-Governance, and Retail & Other Services. The E-Governance segment is dedicated to critical government initiatives, such as preparing electoral rolls, issuing voter photo identity cards, and facilitating Aadhaar enrolment services, along with other related support. Conversely, the Retail & Other Services segment concentrates on offerings like multi-recharge services, e-Mitra services, comprehensive system integration, and the supply of devices, complemented by ancillary services. Established on March 30, 2000, Atishay Limited is headquartered in Bhopal, India.
